Встроенная модель Apple как модель ассис: Apple's built-in model as a model for the ViON assistant, with tools and pictures. Runs right on the Mac, without keys and without a cloud.
Apple refuses plain answers about people: Apple refuses plain answers about people at doors, gates and windows. With this on, every answer is requested in a structured form, which the model does answer. Turn it off only to see the refusals themselves.
Uses the permissive guardrail level of t: Uses the more permissive safety level of the model, which refuses fewer everyday camera scenes.
How much the model can hold. Raise it af: How much the model can hold at once. Raise it after a system update that brings a larger window: ViON plans the conversation with this number.
The assistant can look at events, camera: The assistant can look at events, cameras and sensors through this model. ViON fits the tool list to the small context window. Off makes it a plain chat model.
The model looks at event pictures instea: The model looks at event pictures instead of reading only the text around them. Needs macOS 27; on macOS 26 no pictures are sent.
